name: Valheim
why: Valheim quits when Steam does not start (SteamManager, ZNet) and has no offline mode, so its Steamworks stub signs in as an offline user: cloud saves off, local worlds and characters only. PlayFab Party (crossplay) fails to initialise, so online play stays off. Graphics settings come in per-platform configurations with none for iOS, so the game takes the Mac's. Steamworks.NET's server-list and ping responders hand instance-method delegates to native code, which IL2CPP refuses; guarding their constructors lets ZSteamMatchmaking start (it is needed to start any world, local ones too).
